how_to_use: This is the Canon knowledge selected for this request. It is durable creative and production knowledge — what makes work good and what commonly goes wrong. It says nothing about which image or video model to use, what a provider charges, or whether a model can execute something reliably. Read each item with its `epistemics`: a claim the source hedged is not a rule, a caveat marked extractor_observed is this project's doubt rather than the author's, and a binding marked proposed has not been reviewed by anyone. Items are delivered in full unless `delivered_complete` is false; `detail_ref` fetches the untruncated object in the rare case you need it.

content.claim: A screen position edit uses the placement of subjects in two shots to move the viewer's eyes around the screen. One strong element occupies one side of the frame and directs attention or movement toward the other; the incoming shot puts the object of that attention on the opposite side, satisfying the viewer's need to see something occupy that space. Also called a directional or placement edit. It can be a cut or a dissolve, but is usually a cut where no passage of time is implied.
source_words: "Directional" because the edit helps direct the viewer's eyes around the screen, and "placement" because it is the unique placement of subjects or objects in the two shots cut together that make the viewer's eyes move around the frame.
one strong visual element occupies one side of the frame and casts its attention or a movement toward the other side
content.mechanism_text: The mirrored composition creates and then discharges an expectation: the viewer's eyes are on one side, the attention in frame points across, and the cut rewards the movement by placing the new subject where the eyes were sent.
content.scope_conditions: coverage designed, through storyboards or script notes, to lead the eye across the frame

caveats.text: the source states plainly that not every screen position edit will address all six elements, "but the more the merrier" — a third instance of the framework being treated as optional
the source says the shots must have been conceived and composed for this purpose during production, so the category describes what an editor can recognise rather than create

content.rationale: Judgement is made against an implied viewing scale, and the source states that judging on a miniature systematically distorts it. Its remedy is to reconstruct the delivery conditions artificially — a thousand-seat theatre, a thirty-foot screen, no possibility of further change. The transferable constraint is that an asset should be assessed at its delivery scale, which for this product is a phone in a feed rather than a cinema.
content.applicability_when: deciding the conditions under which a generated asset is reviewed
content.applicability_limits: The source's specific scale is theatrical and its remedy is a physical prop. Only the principle transfers, and this product's delivery scale is smaller than the review scale rather than larger, so the distortion may run the opposite way.

epistemics.binding_status_reason: not reviewed — the inversion of the scale relation for feed-native work is our observation and is untested

content.label: devices_by_which_a_reproduced_indian_advertisement_carries_its_whole_argument
content.description: Six devices observed by inspecting the book's plate insert, in which the advertisement's argument is carried by the image and its construction rather than by copy: a familiar everyday scene recruited as the demonstration; a single abstract symbol under an instruction headline; a mascot inserted into a foreign icon set at reduced scale; a fixed form with one variable joke slot; a sung word typeset as the picture; and vernacular appropriation carried simultaneously by word, script and setting.
content.whole_system_claim: Across these executions the verbal load is low or absent and the work is done by what is depicted and how it is arranged — which means a text-only representation of this book would lose the evidence for most of its craft claims, and which also means each device depends on cultural knowledge the viewer must already hold.

tradeoffs.nature: dense documentary photograph versus one abstract symbol — opposite ends of a density range, both carrying the whole argument

epistemics.whole_system_claim_interpretation_basis: The source supplies only a one-line caption per plate and never discusses composition, typography, scale or layout for any of them. Every structural observation in this system was made by CANON-014 opening the images. The grouping asserts a family resemblance the author never proposes. It is offered as a hypothesis about the plates, not as a report of the book.
epistemics.system_level_uncertainty: High, and higher than any member. Each member is an observation about one plate that CANON-014 made first-hand and can be re-checked against the named image file. The claim that the eight constitute one family of devices is entirely the extractor's synthesis over a plate insert the book's own text never analyses. A different reader could group them differently or reject the grouping. This system is a hypothesis about Indian advertising craft, and it must not be consumed as Parameswaran's position — he does not have one on this.

content.label: image_as_the_thing_actually_bought
content.description: A connected account of why image rather than product is what advertising sells: products in a category are often materially alike, consumers experience the name's associations as properties of the thing, so image becomes the differentiator, is built by consistency over decades, and defaults to quality for products consumed in public.
content.whole_system_claim: Where products are alike, what the consumer buys is the image, and the image is the advertiser's actual product. It is built only by projecting the same personality year after year, it defaults to an impression of quality for anything consumed visibly, and for parity products it is the only remaining ground of difference.

tradeoffs.nature: differentiate by advertising style, or drop comparison entirely and simply establish that the product is positively good; the source offers both for the same situation

epistemics.system_level_uncertainty: Membership and the core claim are source-stated; the chapter treats image as a single connected subject across consecutive sections. The trade-off and the conflict are ours. The conflict is the more interesting of the two, because it sets two of the chapter's best-known prescriptions against each other.

content.rationale: SPEC-01's hierarchy is a rank ordering of what the creative prioritises. This source supplies the reason the ordering has to be acted on rather than merely recorded: an audience given many good points retains none, so ranking without exclusion does not help. It argues for treating a low-ranked element as a candidate for removal rather than for smaller placement.
content.applicability_when: a hierarchy has been specified and the asset carries every ranked element
content.applicability_limits: The source's support is one quoted practitioner remark about juries. The claim that exclusion beats de-emphasis is a reading of that remark, not something the source states about visual composition, and it is recorded as ours.

content.claim: In her Conclusion Jain describes what she sees replacing the older arrangement after economic liberalisation: "there appears to be a double movement at work, such that one set of processes creates identifiable symbols of cultural identity while another lays down the universal ground within which these markers of difference operate." She names the mechanism in the trade: "advertising agencies in India — the new Ravi Varmas, if you will — often use proprietary analytical model …[truncated — full text via detail_ref]
source_words: advertising agencies in India - the new Ravi Varmas, if you will
content.mechanism_text: A universal analytical template with local content slots produces difference that is real at the level of content and absent at the level of structure. Because the template is what determines which differences are askable about, the differences that survive are exactly those the template can hold — which is why they converge on portable markers like dress, food and festivals.
content.scope_conditions: Written from observation up to roughly 2004-2006 and published 2007. Jain's evidence is the transformation of one named Sivakasi firm (Srinivas Fine Arts) between her 1990s and 2001 visits, plus the media landscape she describes.
content.interpretation_basis: Jain's own reading of the post-liberalisation period, built from her 2001 return visits to Sivakasi and from observation of the media landscape. She marks it as interpretation, offering it as what "appears to be" under way.

caveats.text: SEVERE FRESHNESS RISK. This is a description of a media and advertising landscape as of roughly 2001-2006. It predates the Indian smartphone and streaming eras entirely. It is retained as a historical characterisation of a transition, not as a description of the present
the generalisation rests on one firm's transformation observed at two points, plus the author's reading of television, cinema and print. It is an impression carefully drawn, not a study

Jain herself insists the process does not mean the demise of vernacular economies, and gives the cable-television 'last mile' as a counter-case where informality persisted and shaded into criminality. An extraction that took only the homogenising half would misreport her

Evidential assessment recorded by the extractor, moved here from evidence.source_uncertainty when that field was returned to its controlled SPEC-03 vocabulary: An interpretive characterisation of a period, drawn from limited but well-chosen observation.

content.rationale: SPEC-01's composition field names framing and figure-ground. This source supplies a small, closed vocabulary for the figure-ground part of it: a concrete subject sits in one of three approximate zones, and each zone determines the relationship between subject and background — off-centre shows both together, centred divides and diminishes the background, extreme subordinates the subject to the setting.
content.applicability_when: specifying or reading where a single concrete subject sits within a still frame
content.applicability_limits: The zones are regions with soft, overlapping boundaries, not coordinates — the source's own diagram draws them with gradients wide enough to overlap, and the source doubts any rule of thirds can be more than approximate. A specification recording a zone is therefore recording an intent, not a position, and must not be read back as a measurement. The scheme also presupposes a subject small enough in the frame that there is a choice, and says nothing about images of patterns, fields or generalities.
